granularity_note: One objective per learning outcome in the "Candidates should be able to" column, with the "Notes and guidance" column carried as syllabus_guidance. papers_note: Sections 1-8 are assessed on Paper 1 and sections 9-12 on Paper 2 (syllabus, page 11). Each objective carries the paper that assesses it.
